title: Choose the owner's visual world
question: The re-roll assigned Tenun Songket, and your steer added the renter's own poster as a card. Keep one, take an alternate, or re-roll again.

options.label: Tenun Songket
options.lineage: the Jambi songket loom — a ground of warp threads under a weft of gold-graded cells, one cloth woven a row a day, the live row still on the loom
options.thesis: The week woven once: every outlet a column, every day a row, and the gold grade of each cell is how full that outlet ran.
materials: a gold thread marking the live day
options.viewport: A dark woven ground under the balance, then a 5×5 cloth — five outlets as columns, five days as rows, each cell gold-graded by how full the outlet ran, the late day outlined red and the live day threaded in gold.
options.risk: A cloth is decorative before it is diagnostic; if the grade is not read as a figure, the owner sees pattern where a number should be.

raised.raise: The weave tiles on one named CSS grid under strict hairline rules, each outlet row headed by a small gold tab — five outlets stay one field, never a stack of padded cards.
One flip turns the cloth over as two hard halves — pekan ini and pekan lalu — so the week reverses in place and the two halves never mix.
The cloth sheds its oldest day-rows from the edges as the phone narrows, so the weave never scrolls sideways; reduced-motion holds a single still.

options.label: Papan Skor
options.lineage: the stadium scoreboard — big segmented lamp figures on a dark board, a changed figure lit and held so you catch it after the fact
options.thesis: The owner checks a score, not a report: the day's takings and the fleet's count as big figures that light when they move.
options.viewport: A dark board under a standard period tab, one lamp figure for the day's saldo with a lit delta, then five outlet rows of big figures and a state dot.
options.risk: Every run in this category reaches for a scoreboard; familiar is not the same as finished, and a lit figure says 'changed' but never why.

options.label: Poster Solidaritas
options.lineage: the renter app's own solidarist silkscreen — flat saturated fields under an ink border, Archivo Black set hard against paper, held to type, palette, density and one move
options.thesis: Owner and renter speak one language: the same flat poster world carries the owner's oversight screen, so the whole network reads as a single voice.
options.viewport: An ink-bordered paper sheet: the brand band, a standard period tab in ink, a flat red plate carrying the running saldo, five flat-filed outlet rows, and the week's earnings as stacked flat colour bands with the live day reversed.
options.risk: Carrying the renter's campaign world onto an oversight screen risks reading as a poster rather than a console; it buys a single network voice only if the owner's daily read stays as fast as a plain table.

options.label: Diagram Tengah Malam
options.lineage: the midnight-blue transit mural — porcelain station ticks, coloured line inks bending only at 45 and 90 degrees, interchange circles blooming where lines cross
options.thesis: The network drawn as service: five outlets as stations on one corridor, each state a line colour, the delayed station burning brightest.
options.viewport: A midnight ground under a standard period tab and a map panel: one cobalt corridor through five station ticks with a green branch, the late station ringed scarlet, then the four states listed by line colour.
options.case: Fuses on clarity: the state of the network drawn as one corridor is exactly how an owner should read where it is straining, and everyone can already read a transit map — but a metro diagram says 'a city', and a bike-rental owner may not see themselves as its operator.
options.risk: Four competing line inks fight; the world is the most-reached-for network metaphor, so a strong result here still risks reading as the category default.

options.label: Katalog Saville
options.lineage: the factory records catalog sleeve — matte black with no name on it, a white hairline pulse plot as the only body ink, and labels coded as a strip of hue blocks
options.thesis: The fleet as a strict catalog: every outlet a fac number, the week a white pulse on black, each state a colour you learn to decode.
options.viewport: A matte black field: the fac header, a white pulse plot of the week's accrual over a grey prior-week line, one decoded entry, then a five-row fac index whose colour strips carry the state.
options.case: Fuses on identity: a strictly-sequenced catalog of your own fleet reads as ownership and the pulse plot is honest data — but the coded strips ask the owner to learn a legend a plain label would not.
options.risk: Coding is a password; on a screen checked daily, having to decode a colour to learn a state is a cost that the poster never pays.

options.label: Rel Rujukan
options.lineage: the wide-margin reference setting — two short-measure columns twinned around a fixed centre rail of keys and square detents, everything drawn by a ruling engine at one device pixel
options.thesis: The owner's daily read set as a reference page: outlet and figure in twinned columns, the centre rail the one moving part that marks what changed.
options.viewport: A bone sheet: the brand head, two dense columns of outlet names and figures around a vermilion centre rail of square detents, one detent open on each outlet that moved, the running saldo bracketed in the wide margin.
options.case: Fuses on clarity: two honest columns and a rail that marks change is how a ledger should read, and the ruling engine is genuinely functional — but a typesetter's reference page is a specialist's object an owner may not recognise.
options.risk: At phone width two columns go thin; the discipline that makes it calm on a desk can make it cramped in a pocket.

options.label: Mosaik Padat
options.lineage: the Japanese high-density site — dozens of tiny boxed modules packed into one scroll, each ruled with hairlines and headed by a small utility-red tab
options.thesis: The whole network packed into one dense mosaic of boxed modules at tiny type.
options.viewport: A packed mosaic of boxed modules, each with a red tab and tiny figures.
options.case: Fuses to density but not to restraint: it duplicates the category default's density without giving the owner a read the assigned direction lacks, and the mosaic is a shopfront, not a ledger.
options.risk: Packing more in is not the same as seeing more.
options.kept: One named CSS grid with strict hairline rules — modules tile as one field, never a stack of padded cards.

options.label: Pita Kaset
options.lineage: the mixtape j-card — ballpoint block caps ruled onto printed inlay lines, timed to fill exactly one side of the tape
options.thesis: The week as two hand-ruled sides, flipped like a tape between this week and last.
options.viewport: A hand-ruled inlay with two underlined sides and a running time against each line.
options.case: Fuses poorly: hand lettering at block-cap scale starves the density a money screen needs, and the tape is a keepsake rather than a surface the owner runs the network from.
options.risk: Charm on a screen read at 07:00 becomes noise by the third day.
options.kept: One flip turns two hard halves over — pekan ini and pekan lalu — reversing the week in place without mixing them.

options.label: Ladang Data
options.lineage: the data-sublime field — dense barcode columns and sine lattices strobing in pure black and white, the whole frame snapping to its negative
options.thesis: The network as a field of pure data, read by column and by frame.
options.viewport: A wall of hairline vertical bars with a sine curve traced across it and dense monospace numbers in the margin.
options.case: Fuses poorly here: a palette of pure black and white leaves no colour to carry state, so the critical/amber it must show has nowhere honest to sit.
options.risk: A sublime unsuited to a screen whose job is to flag what is wrong.
options.kept: Columns shed from the edges as width shrinks and the still holds under reduced-motion — the field never scrolls sideways.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The owner dashboard this category ships, executed impeccably: a white ground, KPI cards, one line chart, blue accents.
canonCard.viewport: A white ground with a KPI row, a revenue line chart, and a fleet table.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
